stories.title: Putin expresses gratitude, best wishes to Trump
stories.summary: Russian President at a meeting with American negotiators in the Kremlin asked them to convey his gratitude and best wishes to US President Donald
article_sentences: Russian President Vladimir Putin at a meeting with American negotiators in the Kremlin asked them to convey his gratitude and best wishes to US President Donald Trump.

"Before we begin the discussion, I would like to ask you to convey my best wishes and gratitude to the President of the United States, Mr. Trump," Putin said at the beginning of his conversation with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
